status: Frozen analysis rules; fresh source selection pending user decision
training: All parameters already exported using dev only. Fresh inference reads NPZ coefficients, never calls fit.
aggregation: Main mean over primary nodes. Bootstrap samples task UIDs and recomputes node-weighted means, preserving all within-task node dependence. Transformation excluded from main gates.
oracle: Quality-max oracle over three models; ties choose largest realized frozen utility then fixed pool order. Utility oracle separately descriptive, not an extra deployed method.
best_fixed: For F1/F3 only: max measured mean Q among three fixed models, recomputed within each bootstrap; hindsight diagnostic, never used for routing parameters.
F1: At least one of Extraction/Reasoning has Q_qualityOracle > Q_bestFixed. Report task-paired CIs and contribution counts.

F2.efficiency_path: Q_NodeRouter > Q_QueryRouter AND abs(Q_NodeRouter-Q_AlwaysLarge)<=0.01 AND mean_tokens_NodeRouter < mean_tokens_AlwaysLarge
F2.statistical_support: Report query contrast CI95 lower>0; efficiency confirmation additionally requires AlwaysLarge quality contrast CI95 inside [-.01,.01] and token contrast CI95 upper<0. Directional gates and statistical confirmation reported separately.

F3: Quality recovery (Q_NodeRouter-Q_bestFixed)/(Q_qualityOracle-Q_bestFixed)>0. If denominator <=0, undefined/inconclusive, never force zero or divide by epsilon.
final_claim: Only close Static evidence gate if F1/F2/F3 directional gates pass and Node-vs-Query CI95 lower>0. Otherwise report unconfirmed, do not tune or start Feedback.
cost: Measured tokens/inference-call accounting, not monetary billing. Extraction operands sharing one response counted once in per-method physical execution cost; legacy per-node cost separately reported.
latency: Per-call measured request latency and deduplicated per-task service sum. Conditional node-table replay cannot establish end-to-end DAG latency.
missing: Transport failures retained as missing. Do not impute correctness/cost zero or delete silently; main complete-panel gate remains inconclusive if any required candidate cell is missing.
